description: Pinned Setup title, step and progress (REQ-025; C52, G17, R24; AC-C52-01, AC-R025-01; JOURNEY-025). On the real Setup / onboarding equipment screen (/onboarding, reached through the existing auth and onboarding guards) Set up CLEAR is the shared AppHeader title and the route's SetupProgress (the shared Progress, a named visible progressbar 'Step N of 5') is Screen's pinnedHead under it: one pinned head (src/app/Screen.tsx, src/styles/shell.css) closed by one full-width divider - the header hands its own rule to the head's - with the scroller starting at that divider, so the equipment list scrolls below it and never under it. No bespoke sticky overlay, no second divider, no hidden progress; every equipment choice takes keyboard focus in view below the head and above the pinned footer; touch, reduced motion, a reopen, the step controls and a failed commit (said, draft kept, retry sends the same draft) keep the pinned head. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=screens (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) adds a Setup part drawing the route's own SetupProgress and SetupStepView in the same shared Screen structure over an in-memory draft that reads and writes nothing. check-01 proves it in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session; every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-025 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-025.spec.ts --project=mobile
